turns.user: I purchased a mobile single ticket in BudapestGO yesterday. Can I replace it with another ticket?
turns.agent:
I can’t replace or exchange a BudapestGO ticket for you, and the snapshot I have doesn’t establish whether a mobile single ticket bought yesterday can be replaced or refunded. For that specific case, check BKK’s ticket prices and conditions (https://bkk.hu/en/tickets-and-passes/prices/) or contact BKK through its official support channels; I don’t want to guess about the app’s replacement rules.

If you tell me what you need the replacement ticket for (for example, a different route or a longer period of travel), I can help you identify a suitable fare option. This advice is based on a static BKK-information snapshot dated 5 November 2026, not a live check. I’m an independent educational demo, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by BKK.
